purpose: Find the authenticated formal-candidate source-version chain using repository code and small historical seals, without rereading E38-E41 inputs, quality tables or runtime results.

static_chain.fact: Package manifest source_sha256 binds candidate_receipt, candidate_space and normalized_measurements.
Candidate receipt sha256.source_provenance binds a provenance TSV recording original source byte SHA separately from normalized copy SHA, circuit, stage, row count and basename.
Historical repository seal declares package manifest SHA and aggregate candidate/normalized hashes; this alone does not identify each original source version.

new_local_access_observation.operation: One exact Get-Item metadata/stat attempt, no content open

minimal_export_request.verification: An authorized reader/exporter must attest selected fields to complete byte hashes and preserve namespace/order. Manually copying hash strings is not independent authentication. Do not export full package manifest (it includes quality-derived values), candidate tables, outcomes, runtime or checkpoints.

search_hygiene: An initial repository content search was too broad and tool output was truncated, including historical result summaries. Those matches were not used as source-version, runtime or quality evidence. Subsequent inspection was restricted to named small metadata/code files. No raw label table or protected directory was opened.
proposed_alternative_not_authorized_or_e: If the user explicitly permits a new remote scope, perform bounded metadata-only discovery on existing B under /ssd/cjc, excluding /ssd/cjc/multimode_ate_gnn_v1 before any target access. Only the three named metadata files/selected fields and TRAIN provenance; no quality artifacts, checkpoint, training, remote writes or broad extraction. Existence of a usable B copy is not yet established.
